description: This class manages batch operations on Android's Contacts provider, allowing multiple contact modifications to be applied as a batch.

classes.name: BatchOperation
classes.description: A utility class for performing batch operations on the Contacts content provider.

methods.name: BatchOperation
methods.description: Constructor to initialize with context and resolver.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of operations queued.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a ContentProviderOperation to the batch list.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes all queued batch operations and returns list of resulting URIs.
